title: Welcome to Rho-Bank Checking
summary: “Welcome to Rho-Bank Checking” explains how to enroll in online/mobile access, add a debit card to a digital wallet, and set up direct deposit. It also covers bill pay, scheduled payments/reminders, internal/external transfers (in a matter of days), account alerts, and getting help via secure messaging or in-profile calls.
faqs: How do I enroll in online and mobile access for my Rho-Bank checking account?
Can I add my Rho-Bank debit card to a digital wallet, and how does it help?
How do I set up direct deposit to streamline cash flow?
How do I pay bills and schedule payments with reminders?
What alerts can I set (e.g., low balance, large transactions, deposits)?
How do I get help from support through my online banking profile?
keywords: external transfers in a matter of days
